note: ISS Phase 5 labour market (sim/modern/econ/labour.gd). Labels: S sourced, D derived, T declared until a published estimate replaces it.

u_star.label: S
u_star.source: 総務省 労働力調査 2024年11月 完全失業率 季節調整値 2.5%; e-Stat 000040238045; published 2024-12-27 (R96, R96b)

rho.label: T
rho.source: monthly persistence of the unemployment rate toward its target

okun_k.label: T; the gap is a held row (M002 G9): the modelled sectors' only, so u is held except for their share (a complete collapse of food manufacturing moves u's target by 0.85 pt at most) until the other sectors' gaps exist
okun_k.source: Okun-type: the target falls 0.5 pt per 1% of the modelled sectors' employment-weighted use gap (Japan's Okun coefficient is small, of order 0.2-0.5)

food_manufacturing.label: D (to confirm)
food_manufacturing.source: 経済構造実態調査 2022 製造業 食料品製造業 従業者 約115万人 / 労働力調査 2024年11月 就業者 6,814万人 (e-Stat 000040238045, published 2024-12-27); the sectors not modelled are held at their published state

w_pi.label: T
w_pi.source: wage pass-through of expected inflation a year

w_u.label: T
w_u.source: wage response to the unemployment gap a year

w_demand.label: T
w_demand.source: wage response to the share of unions with a wage demand
